## Workflow

Which documented workflow did you test?

## Environment

Include hardware, runtime image or build, command, and relevant versions.

## Result

Describe whether the workflow reproduced, partially reproduced, failed, or needs retest.

## Metrics

Separate backend metrics from client wall-time metrics.

## Redacted Evidence

Attach only redacted logs or screenshots.

## Notes

Do not include private hostnames, private IPs, private paths, secrets, payment data,
participant data, or supplier details.
